title: Noisy-caller SLO gating and trace-sampler tuning for burn-rate fidelity
creator: Asha Kapoor
description: Reduce false-positive SLO burn-rate alerts caused by high-volume noisy callers and uneven trace sampling. Deliver a combination of caller-level noise gating, dynamic trace-sampler policies, and dashboard filters so paging is reserved for action-worthy incidents while preserving SLO fidelity for customer-impacting paths.
acceptance_criteria: Caller-level noise scoring computed in ingestion pipeline and surfaced in /slo/aggregate queries
Configurable noise gating rule UI in Console to mute callers below impact threshold
Trace-sampler adaptive policy deployed that increases sample rate for callers crossing latency/error percentiles
Burn-rate alert responsiveness improves (reduction in false positives) by >= 40% on historical replay for the test dataset
Playbook updates and runbook automation so oncall receives context-rich pages (top callers, recent traces, regression diff)
updates: 2026-03-02: Kickoff call with Observability, SRE, and Platform engineers. Agreed success metric is reduction of noise-driven burn-rate pages by 40% on replay. Action items: produce a 30-day replay dataset and prototype caller scoring in ingestion (Confluence: https://confluence.redwood.com/display/OBS/Noisy+Caller+Gating).

2026-03-04: PoC of caller scoring implemented in kafka-telemetry-processor branch: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/1428. Scoring heuristic: weighted combination of request-rate volatility, error-rate concentration, and latency z-score. Early results on staging show top 20 callers account for 72% of burn-rate noise.

2026-03-06: Design review with Product and SRE. Trade-offs discussed: pre-ingest caller gating vs. post-ingest suppression. We opted for post-ingest scoring + downstream gating to preserve raw events for audits and replay. Documented decision in Confluence page and design doc link: https://confluence.redwood.com/display/OBS/Noisy+Caller+Design+Decisions.

2026-03-09: Implemented adaptive trace-sampler prototype that uses caller score + rolling latency percentile to bump sampling from 0.1% to up to 10% for suspicious callers. Deployed behind feature flag and instrumented via feature-flagging (LaunchDarkly: obs-noise-gating).

2026-03-11: Replayed 30-day telemetry dataset through the gating logic in a dry-run. Burn-rate alert count reduced by 47% in dry-run, but a small class of high-impact but low-volume errors were under-sampled. Action: add whitelist override for traced endpoints tied to revenue (PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/1439).

2026-03-12: Working on Console UI for configurable gating rules and whitelist. Backend API design landed in PR #1457. Scheduling canary rollout to 10% of tenants next week after SRE runbook updates are complete.
notes_and_links: Incident example that motivated this work: INC-2026-02-17-high-burn-rate (summary attached in Confluence page)
